mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.subject_id, f.object_value->>'value' AS value FROM facts f JOIN relation_types nr ON nr.id = f.predicate_id LEFT JOIN name_vectors v ON v.fact_id = f.id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = #{knownAs} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.object_value IS NOT NULL AND v.fact_id IS NULL ORDER BY f.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO name_vectors (fact_id, kb_id, entity_id, embedding) VALUES (#{factId}, #{kbId}, #{entityId}, #{embedding}::vector) ON CONFLICT (fact_id) DO UPDATE SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding
mapper.select: WITH near AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT v.fact_id AS id, v.entity_id, (v.embedding::vector(${dims}) <=> #{query}::vector(${dims})) AS distance FROM name_vectors v WHERE v.kb_id = #{kbId} AND vector_dims(v.embedding) = ${dims} ORDER BY v.embedding::vector(${dims}) <=> #{query}::vector(${dims}) LIMIT #{scan} ) SELECT n.entity_id, n.id AS fact_id, f.object_value->>'value' AS name, et.label AS type_label, (1 - n.distance)::real AS similarity FROM near n JOIN facts f ON f.id = n.id AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL JOIN entities e ON e.id = n.entity_id AND e.merged_into IS NULL LEFT JOIN entity_types et ON et.id = e.type_id ORDER BY n.distance + 0, n.id LIMIT #{k}
